description:
Discriminator: 'approximate_render_sample'.
Returned during live 3D viewport raycast hover/click interactions.
Explicitly carries an approximation warning and error confidence bounds.

approximate_value.description: Value sampled from GPU texture or quantized buffer.
approximate_value.title: Approximate Value

approximation_notice.default: PROVISIONAL VALUE: Interpolated from GPU rendering volume. Query /queries/value for authoritative scientific data.
approximation_notice.title: Approximation Notice

display_units.description: Display units corresponding to the current transfer function.
display_units.title: Display Units

estimated_sample_error_bound.description: Theoretical error bound based on LOD downsampling and texture quantization.
estimated_sample_error_bound.title: Estimated Sample Error Bound

lod_level.description: LOD level of the sampled brick.
lod_level.title: Lod Level

response_type.description: Discriminator identifying this as an approximate rendering texture sample.
response_type.title: Response Type

visualization_product_id.description: ID of the visual product under the raycast cursor.
visualization_product_id.title: Visualization Product Id

world_ray_hit_position.description: [x, y, z] position in 3D Volume Lab world space where ray intersection occurred.
world_ray_hit_position.title: World Ray Hit Position

title: ProvisionalRenderPickResponse
